html: † [אחר] pl. c. אַחֲרֵי, prep. after (Cappad. and Egyptian Aramaic אחר afterwards (LzbEph. i. 361 S-CPap. C 8), prob. Nab. אחר after (Lzb212 SAC 16); Egyptian Aramaic אחריכם (S-CPap. C 8 +); 𝔗 (sometimes) אֲחוֹרֵי; BH אַחַר);—אַחֲרֵי דְנָה after this Dn 2:29, 45; c. sf. אַחֲרֵיהֹן 7:24. Usually Aramaic syn. בָּאתַר, q.v.
